title: The factorial of a natural number is always at least 1
statement: For every natural number n, n! ≥ 1 (the factorial is never zero).

formal.statement: theorem Nat.one_le_factorial : ((x0 : AxNat) -> AxNat.le (AxNat.succ AxNat.zero) (AxNat.factorial x0))

evidence.supports: For every natural number n, n! ≥ 1 (the factorial is never zero).
